title: WEIGHTED SPATIAL STATISTICS ON A VOLUME FILE
description:
For each subvolume of the input, a line of text is printed, resulting from the specified operation.  If -weight-volume is not specified, each voxel's volume is used.  Use -subvolume to only give output for a single subvolume.  If the -roi option is used without -match-maps, then each line will contain as many numbers as there are maps in the ROI file, separated by tab characters.  Exactly one of -mean, -stdev, -percentile or -sum must be specified.

Using -sum without -weight-volume is equivalent to integrating with respect to volume.

match_maps.description: each subvolume of input uses the corresponding subvolume from the weights file

weight_volume.description: use weights from a volume file

subvolume.description: only display output for one subvolume

roi_volume.description: the roi, as a volume file

match_maps.description: each subvolume of input uses the corresponding subvolume from the roi file

roi.description: only consider data inside an roi

sample.description: estimate population stdev from the sample

show_map_name.description: print map index and name before each output
